sections.description: Theme-independent block-based popups with targeting, accessible dialogs, and manual triggers.
sections.changelog:
= 2.2.2 =
* Receive the licensing connection through the existing GitHub updater. Connect once under Settings → MTT updates for future official updates; installed features keep working.
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 2.2.1 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 2.2.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with encrypted storage and manual site approval.
* Protect official update delivery while keeping installed features working.

= 2.0.5 =
* Use a gentle fade when opening popups, without sliding or zooming the content.

= 2.0.4 =
* Prepare popup blocks before WordPress collects layout styles so saved block gaps render on block themes.

= 2.0.3 =
* Honor no-memory display settings immediately, ignoring dismissals saved under an earlier policy.

= 2.0.2 =
* Display the official Made to Thrive circle badge in WordPress plugin updates.

= 2.0.1 =
* Use the plugin name without an MTT prefix; retain Made to Thrive authorship and the handwritten mtt icon.

= 2.0.0 =
* Extract the reusable engine from the Butternut installation into the shared plugin repository.
* Remove client artwork, newsletter styles, theme palette dependencies, and theme-specific content/navigation hooks.
* Add neutral configurable dialog styling, per-post metadata authorization, and standard update integration.
* Isolate dialogs from theme wrappers and preserve focus/background state when reopening.

== Upgrade Notice ==
= 2.0.0 =
Breaking presentation change: migrate existing client newsletter styles and assets into the client theme before upgrading a branded installation. Saved popup posts and metadata are retained.
